component_union_chart_rule: For each `fc_*` endpoint functional, construct the endpoint-functional chart as a tagged disjoint union of the support components already carrying local $\Psi_j$ formulas. Each component uses the local coordinate $s=(\theta-L)/(R-L)$ and retains its component tag, so no support point is counted twice.
no_promotion_rule: This certificate promotes only the component-union chart, coordinate rule, no-double-counting rule, formal formula-to-chart binding, and target endpoint evaluation locator. It does not promote the locator into endpoint motion, a full domain/evaluation map, exact $B\xi=0$, rank, candidate artifacts, topology, replay, row consumption, or branch-chart authorization.
